args.name: router
args.inline:
set -e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq nftables >/dev/null
echo 'net.ipv4.ip_forward=1' > /etc/sysctl.d/90-isoloom.conf
sysctl -q -p /etc/sysctl.d/90-isoloom.conf
cat > /etc/nftables.conf <<'NFT'
flush ruleset
table inet isoloom {
  chain forward {
    type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop;
    ct state established,related accept
    ip saddr 10.61.99.0/24 ip daddr 10.61.10.0/24 accept
    ip saddr 10.61.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.61.20.0/24 meta l4proto { tcp, udp } th dport { 6379 } accept
    ip saddr 10.61.10.0/24 ip daddr 10.61.20.0/24 icmp type echo-request accept
  }
}
NFT
systemctl enable nftables
nft -f /etc/nftables.conf

args.name: hosts
args.inline: for l in '10.61.10.10 web' '10.61.99.10 user'; do grep -qxF "$l" /etc/hosts || echo "$l" >> /etc/hosts; done

args.name: routes
args.inline:
mkdir -p /etc/isoloom
cat > /etc/isoloom/routes.sh <<'ROUTES'
#!/bin/sh
# Routes to the other isoloom networks.
ip route replace 10.61.10.0/24 via 10.61.20.254 2>/dev/null || true
ip route replace 10.61.99.0/24 via 10.61.20.254 2>/dev/null || true
ROUTES
chmod +x /etc/isoloom/routes.sh
for d in /etc/network/if-up.d /etc/networkd-dispatcher/routable.d; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then ln -sf /etc/isoloom/routes.sh "$d/zz-isoloom-routes"; fi
done
cat > /etc/systemd/system/isoloom-routes.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Routes to the other isoloom networks
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/etc/isoloom/routes.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable isoloom-routes.service
systemctl restart isoloom-routes.service

args.name: no internet
args.inline:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
command -v nft >/dev/null || apt-get install -y -qq nftables >/dev/null
IF=$(ip route show default | awk '{print $5; exit}')
mkdir -p /etc/isoloom
cat > /etc/isoloom/egress.nft <<NFT
table inet isoloom-egress
delete table inet isoloom-egress
table inet isoloom-egress {
  chain output {
    type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept;
    oifname "$IF" ct state new drop
  }
}
NFT
cat > /etc/systemd/system/isoloom-egress.service <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=No new connections out through the NAT interface
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/nft -f /etc/isoloom/egress.nft

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable isoloom-egress.service
systemctl restart isoloom-egress.service

args.name: wait for cache
args.inline: i=0; until (bash -c '</dev/tcp/cache/6379' 2>/dev/null || nc -z -w 2 cache 6379 2>/dev/null); do i=$((i+2)); if [ $i -ge 300 ]; then echo "cache didn't answer within 300s" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 2; done; echo "cache answers"
